entry: Actuator HTTP health group alias and component

questions.prediction: Issue #48374 reports a startup error requiring a single segment on the parent. The merged application should start and return HTTP 200 with `status=UP` and `components.diskSpace`.
questions.basis: The integration fixture exposes exactly that contributor in the group. A JSON membership check distinguishes the group from another healthy endpoint.
questions.refutation: Startup still rejects the path, or the URL returns 404 or a different group’s body.

questions.history: Use `server:/healthz` with the same group, contributor, and component visibility.
questions.prediction: Both revisions should serve the same healthy group and its `diskSpace` member at `/healthz`.
questions.basis: The single-segment form was supported before the change and appears in the reference guide.
questions.refutation: A previously usable alias fails or returns a different component selection.

questions.history: Configure two groups with distinct healthy marker contributors. Give them aliases `server:/probe` and `server:/probe/deep`, using group names unrelated to `probe`. Request both exact aliases and `/probe/deep/<deep-marker>` on the merge.
questions.prediction: Each exact alias should expose its own marker. The longer path’s marker request should return that component’s `UP` result. Reversing group declaration order should preserve those observations.
questions.basis: The PR specifies longest-prefix selection. Different marker names detect the shorter group winning and exercise the number of consumed segments.
questions.refutation: The shorter group shadows the longer one, a covered component path returns 404, or declaration order changes the selected group.
